x-code.source: // Debounce — delay a call until the caller stops firing. export function debounce(fn, wait = 200) { let timer = null; return function debounced(...args) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => fn.apply(this, args), wait); }; } // Throttle — run at most once per interval. export function throttle(fn, interval = 100) { let last = 0; return function throttled(...args) { const now = Date.now(); if (now - last < interval) return; last = now; return fn.apply(this, args); }; } const onResize = debounce(() => { const { innerWidth: w, innerHeight: h } = window; console.log(`viewport ${w}x${h}`); }, 250); window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
